title: Additional Cast for 'Hell Mode 2nd Season' Announced
content:
• The official website of the Hell Mode: Yarikomizuki no Gamer wa Hai Settei no Isekai de Musou suru 2nd Season ( Hell Mode: The Hardcore Gamer Dominates in Another World with Garbage Balancing Season 2 ) television anime announced additional cast on Wednesday. The second season adapting Hamuo 's action fantasy light novel will begin airing on Tokyo MX, MBS, and BS Nippon Television in July 2026.

Cast Kir: Reiji Kawashima ( Yuusha Party ni Kawaii Ko ga Ita node, Kokuhaku shitemita. ) Meruru: Miyu Tomita ( Ore dake Level Up na Ken ) Sophialohne: Kiyono Yasuno ( Black Clover ) Volmaar: Hikaru Midorikawa ( Fate/Zero )

Produced by Yokohama Animation Lab , the first season aired in 12 episodes in Winter 2026. Sentai Filmworks licensed the anime, with HIDIVE simulcasting the series with multiple subtitles.

Hamuo began writing the novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in November 2019. Earth Star Entertainment acquired the novel under its Earth Star Novel imprint in July 2020, featuring illustrations by Mo . The 13th volume went on sale on January 15.

Enji Tetta began drawing a manga adaptation on the Comic Earth☆Star web magazine in October 2020. The 13th volume was released on January 9.

J-Novel Club licensed both the light novel and manga for digital release in English in July 2021 and July 2023, respectively. The 11th light novel volume went on sale in December 2025, with the 12th volume planned for an August 5 release. The tenth manga volume was released on April 29.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Additional Cast for 'Tensei Goblin dakedo Shitsumon Aru?' Announced
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Nazuna Miki 's Tensei Goblin dakedo Shitsumon Aru? ( So What's Wrong with Getting Reborn as a Goblin? ) manga revealed the additional cast on Wednesday. The anime is scheduled to premiere in October 2026.

Cast Simon: Banjou Ginga ( Shinigami Bocchan to Kuro Maid 2nd Season ) Eirene: Sayumi Suzushiro ( Tsue to Tsurugi no Wistoria ) Dike: Mao Ichimichi ( Jishou Akuyaku Reijou na Konyakusha no Kansatsu Kiroku. ) Eunomia: Wakana Kuramochi ( Mayonaka Heart Tune )

Ryouta Kawahara ( Hikaru ga Shinda Natsu episode director) is directing the anime at Bakkka . Yuuichirou Momose ( Maou 2099 ) is handling the series composition and script. Hiroyuki Saita ( Cardfight!! Vanguard: overDress ) is designing the characters, while Takenoko Boy ( Tensei Akujo no Kuro Rekishi ending song arrangement) is composing the music.

Miki ( Botsuraku Yotei no Kizoku dakedo, Hima Datta kara Mahou wo Kiwametemita ) began serializing the fantasy manga in Tonari no Young Jump in February 2020, with illustrations by Tsukasa Araki . Shueisha released the 14th volume on March 18.

Yen Press licensed the manga in English in March 2022 and released the ninth volume in November 2025. The tenth volume is scheduled to be released on May 26.

title: Hell Mode Anime Season 2 Announces 4 More Cast Members
content:
The official website for the television anime of writer Hamuo and illustrator Mo 's Hell Mode - The Hardcore Gamer Dominates in Another World with Garbage Balancing ( Hell Mode - Yarikomi Suki no Gamer wa Hai Settei no Isekai de Musō Suru ) light novel series announced four new cast members for its second season on Wednesday. The newly announced cast members are:

Reiji Kawashima as Keel, a boy with strong attachment to money

Kiyono Yasuno as Sophialohne, the princess of an Elven kingdom

Hikaru Midorikawa as Volmaar, Sophialohne's guard

Miyu Tomita as Meruru, a dwarf with a one-in-a-million prowess in military leadership

The anime's staff previously announced that Takahiro Sakurai will join the new season as Helmios.

The anime's first season debuted on television on January 9 at 25:05 (effectively January 10 at 1:05 a.m.), before airing later that night on MBS . The anime then aired on BS NTV on January 11 at 12:00 a.m.). The anime debuted on ABEMA and d Anime Store on January 9 at 25:35 (effectively January 10 at 1:35 a.m.). The anime then debuted streaming on U-NEXT and Anime Hōdai on January 12. HIDIVE streamed the anime as it aired, and it is also streaming an English dub .

Masato Tamagawa ( Saint Seiya: Saintia Shō , The Genius Prince's Guide to Raising a Nation Out of Debt , The Great Cleric ) directed the anime at Yokohama Animation Lab . Daishiro Tanimura ( Magical Destroyers ) was in charge of the series scripts. Kei Tsushima ( The Legend of the Galactic Heroes: Die Neue These ) designed the characters. Misaki Tsuchida , Moyu Kanazaki , Junko Nakajima , Kanade Sakuma , Reiko Abe , Kaho Sawada , BeauDamian , and Tsugumi Tanaka all composed the music.

The band Atarayo performed the first season opening theme song "Haku," and singer Kaya performed the ending theme song "Sanctuary."

Hamuo launched the story on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in November 2019, and the story is ongoing. Earth Star Entertainment began publishing the series in print in July 2020.

Tetta launched the ongoing manga on Comic Earth Star in October 2020.
author: ANN

title: Perfect Addiction 'Light Anime' Unveils Main Cast & Staff, July Debut
content:
The official website for the "light anime" adaptation of Kaoruko Miyama 's Perfect Addiction boys-love manga opened on Wednesday and unveiled the anime's key visual, main cast and staff members, and July premiere on the tvk channel.

The anime stars Yōhei Azakami as Akihito Kuji (left in image above), and Sōma Saitō as Sae Takatsuki.

Akashi Uozomi is directing the anime at IMAGICA Infos and Imageworks Studio , and Izumi Tezuka ( I Want to Live a Long Life to Dote on My Favorite Stepbrother ) is in charge of series scripts. Yayoi Tateishi ( Hokkaido Gals Are Super Adorable! , The Daily Life of a Part-time Torturer ) is the sound director, and Midori Narikiyo ( Apocalypse Bringer Mynoghra ) is composing the music. Kazuya Takahashi is the production supervisor.

Seven Seas Entertainment has licensed the Perfect Addiction manga , and describes the series:

Akihito is a college student obsessed with looks and sex, but he can't stand the handsome-yet-aloof Sae. Things come to a head when Akihito is shot down at a singles mixer by a girl who's set her romantic sights on Sae. Furious, he follows Sae to the hotel district where he learns Sae's secret: he's gay, and a bottom. Sae confesses he's been having trouble feeling pleasure from sex. Breaking through Sae's mental barriers is exactly the lovemaking challenge Akihito needed. It awakens something in them both. Will they ever be able to control themselves again?

The light anime is the second project in the new boys-love label BALLOON, which IMAGICA Infos launched with Dai Nippon Printing (DNP), CYBIRD , and BLUE RIGHTS last year.

The first project was the light anime adaptation of Tenma Asahi 's Saioshi no Gikei o Mederu Tame, Nagaikishimasu! (In Order to Love My Most Beloved Brother-In-Law, I'll Live a Long Life!) light novel series. The light anime premiered on January 3.

DNP spearheaded the concept of "light anime" to create animation at a lower cost on a more "timely" schedule compared to the traditional animation production workflow. The BALLOON label aims to produce four new titles in the 2026 fiscal year, with a goal of establishing a workflow capable of producing 10 or more projects a year by 2028.

The manga launched in Kaiohsha 's Gush online magazine in April 2022. Kaiohsha published the fourth volume on March 10. The manga has more than 1.5 million copies in circulation (including digital sales).

Seven Seas Entertainment will release the second compiled book volume in English on July 21.

title: Re:ZERO Season 4 Reveals Episode 7 Preview Trailer and Image
content:
Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4 has revealed the Episode 7 (Episode 73 overall) preview ahead of its May 20, 2026 premiere. Season 4 began on April 8 and ranked first in the first three of our weekly polls of the season , as well as the sixth one . Studio WHITE FOX is animating. The season will consist of 19 episodes, divided over two consecutive cours / story arcs :

• The Loss Arc: 11 episodes, beginning on April 8, 2026

• The Recapture Arc: 8 episodes, beginning on August 12, 2026

Both arcs will air and stream as part of the same season, continuing the story following the events of Season 3. Considering the episode counts, there will also be a ~2 month break from June 17 (assuming there are no recaps/weekly breaks in-between) until August 12, but the season will still stream over two consecutive cours–Spring 2026 and Summer 2026.

You can watch the preview trailer for the seventh episode below.

Also check out the preview images:

The staff for the 4th season consists of:

• Original Work: Tappei Nagatsuki

• Original Character Design: Shinichiro Otsuka

• Director: Masahiro Shinohara

• Scenario Supervisor: Tappei Nagatsuki

• Series Composition: Masahiro Yokotani

• Character Design / Chief Animation Director: Haruka Sagawa

• Monster Design: Keitaro Chiba

• Prop Design: Goichi Iwahata, Noritaka Suzuki

• Art Setting: Kaoru Aoki (Bihou)

• Art Director: Ryoka Kinoshita (Bihou)

• Color Design: Izumi Sakamoto

• Director of Photography: Miori Miyagi (T2studio)

• 3D Director: Kentaro Ijima (FelixFilm)

• Editor: Hitomi Sudo (REAL-T)

• Music: Kenichiro Suehiro

• Music Production: KADOKAWA

• Sound Director: Jin Aketagawa

• Sound Effects: Yuji Furuya (Swara Production)

• Sound Production: Magic Capsule

• Animation Production: WHITE FOX

The main cast includes:

• Kobayashi Yusuke as Subaru

• Rie Takahashi as Emilia

• Yumi Uchiyama as Puck

• Inori Minase as Rem

• Rie Murakawa as Ram

• Satomi Arai as Beatrice

• Kana Ueda as Anastasia

• Takuya Eguchi as Julius

• Fairouz Ai as Shaula

The first season of the anime aired in 2016, adapting the light novel series by Tappei Nagatsuki and illustrated by Shinichirou Otsuka . The series also announced 10 major projects for its 10th anniversary this year.

title: '"Kimi wo Aisuru Ki wa Nai" to Itta Jiki Koushaku-sama ga Nazeka Dekiai shitekimasu' Announces More Cast
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Kei Misawa and Natsu Mizuno 's "Kimi wo Aisuru Ki wa Nai" to Itta Jiki Koushaku-sama ga Nazeka Dekiai shitekimasu ( The Duke's Son Claims He Won't Love Me yet Showers Me with Adoration ) manga announced a pair of additional casts on Wednesday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on TV Asahi and BS Asahi in July 2026.

Voice actors Daisuke Namikawa ( Kimi ni Todoke ) and Mariko Kouda ( Kore wa Zombie desu ka? of the Dead ) are joining the cast as Lucas Eukrainen and Sophia Eukrainen, respectively.

Hitoyuki Matsui ( Karakuri Zoushi Ayatsuri Sakon ) is directing the anime at Zero-G and Grass . Tomoko Konparu ( Kimi ni Todoke ) is handling the series composition, while Yuuko Yahiro ( Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai: Tensai-tachi no Renai Zunousen ) is designing the characters. Michiru ( Given ) is composing the music.

Misawa and Mizuno began serializing the fantasy romance manga on the BookLive web service in February 2021. Flex Comix published the fifth volume on March 13. The manga is also available in English on the MangaPlaza web service. A novel adaptation launched on BookLive in October 2021.

title: Manga 'Omae, Tanuki ni Naranee ka?' Receives TV Anime Adaptation
content:
Production company Happinet opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Tomo Nagawa 's Omae, Tanuki ni Naranee ka? ( Would You like to Be a Tanuki? ) manga, revealing the main staff, a teaser visual (pictured), and teaser promotional video on Wednesday.

Staff Director: Jun Kamiya ( Kingdom ) Series Composition, Script: Masaki Wachi ( Garo: Guren no Tsuki ) Character Design: Shin Takemoto ( Love All Play animation director) Music: Minako Seki ( Black Clover ) Studio: Nippon Animation

Nagawa originally began drawing the supernatural slice of life series on pixiv and X (formerly Twitter) in August 2020. Comic POOL began serializing the manga in April 2021. Ichijinsha published the ninth volume in October 2025, with the tenth volume going on sale on Monday.

The series ranked fifth in the web category for the 2023 Next Manga Awards , and also ranked sixth in the 2023 Web Manga General Elections .

Synopsis Koganemaru the tanuki heads into the city today, hoping to recruit humans to live on his mountain.

"Hey, why don't you become a tanuki?"

A tired office worker. A host with a bad personality. A bully struggling with his relationship with his parents. Countless people feel burdened and worn down by the problems in their lives. When they reach the end of their rope, he arrives with an offer:

"Maybe you'll recognize what's important if you become a tanuki."

Rediscover what's truly important in life through the magic of transformation! This heartwarming tanuki story will sooth your overworked heart.

Teaser PV

title: Tomo Nagawa's 'Would you like to be a tanuki?' Manga Gets TV Anime
content:
Japanese publisher Ichjinsha announced on Wednesday that Tomo Nagawa 's Would you like to be a tanuki? ( Omae, Tanuki ni Narane--ka? ) manga is inspiring a television anime. The staff unveiled a teaser video and visual for the anime.

Nagawa also drew the below illustration to celebrate the anime's announcement.

Jun Kamiya ( Kingdom season 1, Hikaru no Go , Let's Make a Mug Too ) is directing the anime at Nippon Animation , and Masaki Wachi ( Kingdom season 1 and 2) is supervising and writing the series' scripts. Cocoro Takemoto ( Genbanojō , Hakushon Daimaō 2020 ) is designing the characters. Minako Seki ( Kingdom season 1 and 2) is composing the music.

The manga centers on the mythical tanuki creature Koganemaru, who seeks out humans troubled by life, and asks them if they want to try becoming a tanuki , and in the process rediscover what is important in their own lives.

Nagawa launched the manga in Ichijinsha 's Comic Pool digital manga magazine in April 2021. Ichijinsha published the manga's ninth compiled book volume in October 2025, and will publish the 10th volume on May 25.
author: ANN

title: Home Made Kazoku Hip Hop Group to Return After 10-Year Hiatus
content:
Japanese hip-hop group Home Made Kazoku announced on their official website on Tuesday that the group will return to making music. The announcement noted that the group remains under their old label Ki/oon Music , under Sony Music Labels .

The group went on a hiatus after "The Last Live" concert on December 29, 2016. Before formally announcing their return, they made a surprise announcement on April 19 of their planned appearances in various music festival this summer, starting with the "Kariya Urban Fes. 2026 To the Max" festival on May 31.

Home Made Kazoku is composed of vocalists Micro and KURO along with DJ U-ICHI , who are all the same age. Micro and KURO both lived in the United States; Micro grew up in Kentucky, while KURO lived in Chicago until he was 12. The group formed in 2004 after the members met during college in Aichi Prefecture and made their debut under a major label in May 19 of that year.

The group has since performed theme songs for Bleach , Eureka Seven , Naruto Shippūden , and Naruto Shippūden the Movie: Bonds . The band released their first three albums independently from 2001 to 2004, before signing on to Ki/oon Records Inc. (now Ki/oon Music ) and releasing the rest of their singles and albums through the label. The band released 11th album, Laughin' Road , in February 2015.
author: ANN

Home Made Kazoku is composed of vocalists Micro and KURO along with DJ U-ICHI , who are all the same age. Micro and KURO both lived in the United States; Micro grew up in Kentucky, while KURO lived in Chicago until he was 12. The group formed in 2004 after the members met during college in Aichi Prefecture and made their debut under a major label in May 19 of that year.

The group has since performed theme songs for Bleach , Eureka Seven , Naruto Shippūden , and Naruto Shippūden the Movie: Bonds . The band released their first three albums independently from 2001 to 2004, before signing on to Ki/oon Records Inc. (now Ki/oon Music ) and releasing the rest of their singles and albums through the label. The band released 11th album, Laughin' Road , in February 2015.

title: Manga 'Osananajimi to wa Love Comedy ni Naranai' Ends in Three Chapters
content:
The official X (formerly Twitter) account for Shinya Misu 's Osananajimi to wa Love Comedy ni Naranai ( You Can't Be In a Rom-Com with Your Childhood Friends! ) Manga announced on Tuesday that the series will end in three chapters.

Misu began serializing the romantic comedy manga on the Magazine Pocket web service in March 2022. Kodansha published the 20th volume on May 8.

Kodansha began simulpublishing the manga in English on its K Manga service as You Can't Be In a Rom-Com with Your Childhood Friends! in November 2025.

The series was nominated for the ninth Next Manga Awards in the web category in 2023.

Tezuka Productions produced a 12-episode television anime that aired in Winter 2026 . Crunchyroll streamed the anime with subtitles in multiple languages, as well as an English dub.

Synopsis As a romantic comedy enthusiast, Yonosuke "Eiyuu" Sakai enjoys the stories about childhood friends the most. But he solemnly believes that the flawless, loving childhood friends from his stories exist only in fiction. Though he has two childhood friends of his own—Shio Minamo and Akari Hiodoshi—Eiyuu has never seen either one of them as anything more.

However, now that they are all in high school together, the beauty of the two girls begins to catch Eiyuu's eye. As his interest subtly grows, the girls start to make advances toward him regardless of time or place—but only time will tell if Eiyuu will ever overcome his denial and finally see the girls in another light. [Written by MAL Rewrite]
